description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git apply' with removal patches generated by GNU diff. It sets up various test cases to verify file creation, patch application, and file removal based on different patch files.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, used for setting up and verifying test scenarios.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that a file is empty.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
